references.text: The book of Psalms highlights that God's word and deeds are meant to be known, which resonates with the idea that nothing is hidden that will not be revealed.
In Isaiah it is emphasized that God does not speak in secret, which corresponds with the thought that what is hidden is meant to be disclosed.
Luke repeats this concept, pointing to the recurring biblical truth that what is hidden will become known.
Matthew also highlights that there is nothing hidden that will not be revealed, which aligns with Mark 4:22.
